items.title: Consistent global configuration and scripting options
items.detail: **Missing/partial; specified.** Root options do not provide global `--config`, `--json`, `--non-interactive`, or policy selection. Equivalent controls are scattered among commands.

items.title: Stable machine-output API
items.detail: **Partial.** Successful commands often support JSON; failures, envelope/schema, exit details, and event output are inconsistent. F06/F07/F10 demonstrate the consequences.

items.title: Regression policies for CI
items.detail: **Partial.** Absolute release gates and compatible run deltas exist. `compare` exits for compatibility/coverage, not a configured degradation in score, latency, or cost. Add predeclared regression tolerances and fail rules.

items.title: Complete case-result export
items.detail: **Partial.** Report JSON contains summaries and non-passing evidence. There is no general headless export of every passing/failing case and repetition to JSONL/CSV, with explicit content controls.

items.title: CI report adapters
items.detail: **Missing.** Benchmark-result JUnit/SARIF-style exports are absent. The repository's pytest JUnit files are test evidence, not a user feature.

items.title: Named baselines, tags, and searchable run history
items.detail: **Partial.** Run IDs, status filters, and a limit exist. Baseline aliases, run tags/notes, metadata search, pagination, and promotion of an approved baseline are missing.

items.title: Convenient bounded run controls
items.detail: **Partial.** Plans support selection, repeats, concurrency, retries, timeouts, budgets, caches, and quotas. `run` largely requires editing a plan file. Add validated direct overrides and a dry-run that prints the exact frozen scope.

items.title: Reproducibility controls and provenance
items.detail: **Partial.** Selection/bootstrap seeds and frozen configuration exist. The run CLI does not expose the engine's `run_seed`; local source/dependency/commit provenance is incomplete, as F04 shows.

items.title: Release gates in conversation drafts
items.detail: **Missing; documented limitation.** Gates can be authored in executable plans but not declared through session draft choices/patches.

items.title: Retry only failed application work
items.detail: **Partial.** Engine transient retries and unfinished judge rescoring exist. There is no convenient headless command creating a bounded child run from failed/selected application cases with parent lineage.

items.title: Headless run supervision
items.detail: **Deferred/partial.** Status exists; live pause/stop controls belong to the owning terminal/session. Detached execution and durable external pause/resume/cancel requests are absent.

items.title: Configuration management
items.detail: **Partial.** Config files, setup, and doctor exist. There is no `config show/validate/set` workflow showing effective values and source precedence with secrets redacted, or named provider profiles.

items.title: Structured progress and durable logs
items.detail: **Partial.** Terminal progress and persisted run events exist. Scripts lack a consistent JSONL event stream, log-file selection, verbosity/quiet controls, and documented noninteractive logging contract.

items.title: Warmup and measurement phases
items.detail: **Missing; performance extension.** No bounded warmup count or exclusion phase before latency sampling. Warmup effects and spend need to be accounted explicitly.

items.title: Richer performance statistics
items.detail: **Partial.** Successful final-attempt p50/p95 and failure counts exist. User-facing throughput, p99, dispersion, retry-inclusive elapsed latency, and cold/warm separation are absent.

items.title: Streaming model performance
items.detail: **Missing; performance extension.** Application benchmarking records JSON responses, not streaming token events. TTFT, inter-token latency, output tokens/sec, and streaming completion integrity are unavailable. Assistant reply streaming is already implemented and is a separate capability.

items.title: Segment/slice analysis
items.detail: **Partial.** Case predicates and independent grouping for comparisons exist. Reports lack general summaries by metadata segment, customer, language, difficulty, or model configuration.

items.title: Dataset utilities and versioned suites
items.detail: **Partial.** Validation, candidate review/promotion, episodes, and content hashes exist. General schema-aware CSV/JSON/Parquet import, diff/dedup/split tools, and a named suite catalog are missing.

items.title: Workspace maintenance and portability
items.detail: **Partial.** Migrations and an artifact GC library exist. CLI backup/restore, portable run/session bundles, workspace integrity/repair, retention/storage usage, and safe GC commands are missing. Absolute recorded paths complicate migration.

items.title: Judge repeat/calibration workflow
items.detail: **Partial.** Statistical primitives, native calibration, and comparisons exist. A practical command that repeats/calibrates the configured model judges against reviewed labels is incomplete; F12 affects a helper branch.

items.title: Platform and release confidence
items.detail: **Partial.** Windows/Linux CI is configured; macOS CI is absent, current cross-platform results were not observed, and published support/readiness documents still center on older candidates.

items.title: Advanced scale, load, and modality workflows
items.detail: **Deferred.** Distributed workers, a scalable work queue, open-loop/ramping load profiles, multimodal evaluators, and a dashboard are product extensions. Ordinary concurrency and RPS quotas already exist.
